name: lanes
description: On-demand lane sessions beside your main Claude Code session, from the first idea to release: a mid lane for side work that needs judgement (research, plans, reviews, tests), a low lane for search, scripts and crawling. Works on the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, Vertex AI and Foundry. Status line, /lane, and tools the main model calls.

main_model.title: Main model
main_model.description: The model the main session is meant to run (used by bin/claude-main and to pick which sessions get the effort floor).

main_fallback.title: Main fallback model
main_fallback.description: Second choice for the main session when the main model is overloaded (bin/claude-main passes it as --fallback-model).

main_effort.title: Main effort floor
main_effort.description: The main session never runs below this effort.

mid_model.title: Mid lane model
mid_model.description: Side work that needs judgement: research, plans and drafts, reviews, tests. Write it the Claude API way (claude-sonnet-5-5) and it becomes the Bedrock or Mantle ID, or the model you pinned with ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL; a provider ID or ARN goes through as is. Sonnet 4 and Haiku 4 are never used.

mid_fallback.title: Mid lane fallback model
mid_fallback.description: Second choice for the mid lane; empty for none.

mid_effort.title: Mid lane effort
mid_effort.description: Fixed effort for the mid lane.

low_model.title: Low lane model
low_model.description: Search, listing, collecting references, scripts, crawling, notes. Named the same way as the mid lane's model; Sonnet 4 and Haiku 4 are never used.

low_fallback.title: Low lane fallback model
low_fallback.description: Second choice for the low lane when its model is overloaded or out of reach; empty for none.

low_effort.title: Low lane effort
low_effort.description: Fixed effort for the low lane.

launch.title: How lanes open
launch.description: window: a terminal window per lane (Windows, macOS). background: claude --bg, watch with claude attach <name>.

permission_mode.title: Lane permission mode
permission_mode.description: Passed to each lane as --permission-mode. No one answers a prompt in a background lane, so where auto mode isn't available, pick dontAsk with an allowlist, or manual with lanes in windows.

work_style.title: How you work
work_style.description: Tunes how main splits the work and how the lanes report. auto: main reads it from how you work. developer: code, tests, diffs. planner: research, options and drafts for ideas, products and documents. beginner: plain words, one step at a time, and the lanes check the work for you.

idle_minutes.title: Close an idle lane after (minutes)
idle_minutes.description: A lane with nothing to do closes itself after this long; 0 keeps it open.

nudge_tokens.title: Remind main to hand off after (tokens)
nudge_tokens.description: Once main has read this many tokens of lookups and command output itself since its last hand-off, its next tool result carries a note that a lane could take such work; 0 never reminds it.
